# Benesse Art Site Naoshima

> > Contemporary art museums and site-specific installations across the Setouchi islands of Naoshima, Teshima, and Inujima, featuring works by Claude Monet, James Turrell, Walter De Maria, and Lee Ufan in Tadao Ando-designed architecture.

Benesse Art Site Naoshima is a cultural initiative integrating contemporary art, architecture, and nature across three islands in Japan's Seto Inland Sea. The project includes the underground Chichu Art Museum, Benesse House museum-hotel, Lee Ufan Museum, and numerous site-specific installations that harmonize with the island landscapes.

## Key Topics

- Naoshima (直島) - primary island location
- Teshima (豊島) - island with art installations
- Inujima (犬島) - island art site
- Chichu Art Museum (地中美術館) - underground museum
- Benesse House (ベネッセハウス) - museum and hotel
- Lee Ufan Museum (李禹煥美術館) - dedicated artist museum
- Tadao Ando (安藤忠雄) - architect
- Claude Monet - Water Lilies paintings
- James Turrell - light installations
- Walter De Maria - site-specific works
- Setouchi Triennale (瀬戸内国際芸術祭) - regional art festival
- Site-specific art installations
- Natural light architecture
- Contemporary art in nature

## Museums & Art Venues

- [Chichu Art Museum](https://benesse-artsite.jp/art/chichu.html): Chichu Art Museum featuring Monet, Turrell & De Maria underground works
- [Needle Factory](https://benesse-artsite.jp/art/needle-factory.html): Needle Factory art installation by Ohtake Shinro on Teshima island
